        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        List<int[]> intervals = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            intervals.add(new int[]{Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()), Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken())});
        }
        intervals.add(new int[]{2 * N, 2 * N});
        int current = 0;
        SegmentTree[] dp = {new SegmentTree(N + 1), new SegmentTree(N + 1)};
        dp[0].assign(0, 0);

        int[] arr;
        int size;

        public SegmentTree(int N) {

            tree = new int[4 * N];
            arr = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(arr, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            Arrays.fill(tree, Integer.MAX_VALUE);

            return queryUtil(1, 0, size - 1, Math.max(0, l), r);
